Ticket: nobody notices when the nightly export fails.

You are in a Python repo. jobs/nightly.py runs the export and logs the exception on failure.
When the export fails, also post a message to our Slack incoming webhook (URL in the SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL env var) that includes the exception message. Skip the post if the env var is unset. The job must still exit non-zero.

Leave your changes uncommitted in the working tree.
